name: Individual REITs (Direct Shares)

yield.notes: Monthly-paying REITs like O (Realty Income) provide predictable income. Higher yield but more concentrated risk than ETF.

flags: Single company risk vs ETF diversification
Dividend cuts possible in economic downturns

startup_checklist: Research individual REITs: Realty Income (O), STAG Industrial, National Retail Properties
Check dividend history, payout ratio, and FFO (Funds From Operations) growth
Start with 2-3 REITs across different sectors (retail, industrial, net-lease)
Enable DRIP (dividend reinvestment) or collect as income
Review quarterly earnings to ensure dividend sustainability
failure_modes: REIT dividend cut due to tenant defaults
kill_criteria: Payout ratio consistently above 95% of FFO
sources_note: Yield data from REIT earnings reports and SEC filings.
